messages:
Sam: customer (ACME) reporting p99 spike ~4x since ~09:12 UTC, getting 504s and a bunch of 'invalid token' errors. Ticket: CASE-8912
Anya: I'm digging into traces for tenant-42. p95 up from ~120ms -> 200ms, p99 jumped from ~450ms -> 1.8s. Correlates w/ GPU memory pressure on gpu-07 and repeated OOM restarts on the auth sidecar.
Devon: can you paste the node logs?
Sam: logs excerpt:```kernel: oom_reaper: reaped process 2345 (auth-sidecar) total_vm: 4194304kB anon-rss: 3850208kB
kv_store: warn: shard=17 entries=1.2M size=78GB
alloc: failed to reserve 4096M for tenant-42 request_id=req_0xafe123
request_id=req_0xafe123 route=generate model=redwood-3-large````
Anya: that matches — auth-sidecar crashed 3x (restart-loop) which explains the 'invalid token' responses since the TLS session cache died. Also the serving runtime logged many failed allocations and continuous KV growth (old keys not evicting).
Ira: immediate mitigation options: 1) add tenant-level QPS cap, 2) route tenant-42 to spare pool in us-east-1-b, 3) reduce max_batch_tokens for tenant-42. Which do we want first?
Anya: I'll apply a routing override to spare pool and set a conservative batch cap. Command I'm about to run: `/routing-ctl override set tenant=tenant-42 pool=spare-east-1 ttl=30m`
deploy-bot: routing-ctl: override applied by Anya (4201234578) — tenant-42 -> spare-east-1 (ttl=30m)
Devon: also recommend evicting large KV prefixes: run `kvtool evict --shard 17 --older-than 30d --dry-run` then real evict. And change tenant config: `max_batch_tokens: 512` (was 2048). That reduces peak KV cache pressure.
Sam: customer agreed to temporary throughput reduction. Applying batch cap now and restarting workers on gpu-07.
oncall-bot: initiating graceful restart of worker-12 on gpu-07 (rolling)
oncall-bot: worker-12 restarted at 4201234599, health checks green
Anya: after routing override + restart + batch cap p99 dropped to ~700ms, p95 ~200ms. Auth-sidecar restarts stopped. KV growth rate reduced but still trending up slowly.
Ira: capture follow-ups: (1) eng-runtime to add slab_defrag and increase slab_min_free in allocator configs, (2) add auto-evict policy when shard_size > 60GB, (3) investigate root cause of pinned keys (possible indexing bug).
Devon: I'll open PR with suggested allocator knobs and a metric dashboard (kv_shard_size, slab_fragmentation, alloc_fails) and a short-term evict operator.
Sam: filing summary to customer and linking JIRA: https://jira.redwood/browse/CASE-8912 — notes: routing override, batch cap, worker restart, KV evict scheduled. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Anya: follow-up owner: @Devon for PR, @Ira for long-term allocator tuning, @Anya for postmortem and runbook updates.
Sam: closing triage for now, will re-open if p99 climbs again.
